name: 244112598bec
claim: A mistyped stderr redirect such as 2> 8443 instead of 2>&1 silently creates a file named 8443 holding the CLI usage or error text; such stray untracked files inside a scripts directory can masquerade as configuration or evidence, so check git status untracked entries and their modification times when diagnosing odd tool behavior before trusting the directory.

decisions.notes: A 416-byte argparse usage dump named 8443 sat untracked in the lan_peer_assign scripts directory; it matched an unrecognized-arguments error from an earlier run and was removed after inspection.

rationale: Untracked artifacts left by redirect typos pollute script directories and can mislead later diagnostics; verify against git status before treating directory contents as intentional.
